Example Lone Star Merit Award

The Example Fund rewards high-school seniors heading to college.

Eligibility

Applicants must have an unweighted GPA of at least 3.5.

Applicants should report their AP exam scores, if any.

Benefits

Selected students receive USD 2,500 once.

How to apply

Fill in the online form on this page and upload your documents before the closing date. Shortlisted applicants are invited to an interview with the selection panel, and the results are announced on this page.
